ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell Token Obfuscation - Process Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects TOKEN OBFUSCATION technique from Invoke-Obfuscation

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX("\w+`(\w+|-|.)`[\w+|\s]") OR process_command_line = RGX("({\d})+"\s*-f") OR process_command_line = RGX("(?i)${`?e`?n`?v`?:`?p`?a`?t`?h`?}")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$\\{env\\:path\\}.*"))
